items.prompt: If a repeated ID has a different quantity, what should happen here?

options.text: Raise a conflict without publishing a new result
options.why: A changed payload is not an identical retry.

options.text: Treat the changed payload as the latest snapshot and overwrite the earlier one
options.why: This immutable-execution model requires an explicit conflict, not an unverified last-write-wins correction.

options.text: Treat every conflict as a valid correction automatically
options.why: Corrections need their actual authenticated/versioned protocol.

options.text: Delete the earlier trade from source records
options.why: The helper does not rewrite source evidence.

items.explanation: The toy policy rejects conflicts rather than pretending to implement a real bust/correction stream.
